case: an exponent-form token whose value is an integer

typescript.parser: token-preserving parser (this script), then chirindo jcs

specification.quote: A record containing a non-integer JSON number anywhere is non-conformant.
specification.sentence: Left open: `1e2` is an exponent TOKEN whose VALUE is the integer 100, and the text does not say whether "non-integer JSON number" is read by token or by value. "(no exponent notation)" in the same paragraph governs decimal strings, not number tokens.
